slot.brief: Count skew-symmetric matrices of a given order with entries from a set, or find trace properties of such matrices.

stem: How many $4\times4$ skew-symmetric matrices with entries from $\{-1,0,1\}$ have exactly four nonzero entries?

verdicts.working: A skew-symmetric matrix has six independent off-diagonal entries; each nonzero one contributes two nonzero matrix entries. Choose 2 of the 6 and assign each either sign: \(\binom{6}{2}2^2=60\).

working:
Diagonal entries are zero; the six entries above the diagonal determine the matrix.\nExactly four nonzero entries in the full matrix means two of these six are nonzero.\n$\binom{6}{2}\cdot2^2=60$.

Independent check: A skew-symmetric matrix has six independent off-diagonal entries; each nonzero one contributes two nonzero matrix entries. Choose 2 of the 6 and assign each either sign: \(\binom{6}{2}2^2=60\).
